context: Build one shared boundary contract and drive it through the public payload, private/export metadata, and database serialization paths. Test raw_config, raw_metadata, and each normalized mapping with distinct sentinels, plus non-secret tuning fields that must survive. Re-drive the exact unfixed gate immediately before implementation because #1468 is currently open and conflicting. Do not treat a passing focused test on one mapping as coverage of the other layers.
description: Close the remaining platform metadata egress gap across public result payloads, private exports, and ResultDatabase metadata. The landed raw_config work covers one source, but current develop and the candidate boundary still allow raw_metadata plus normalized platform_deployment, platform_cloud, platform_compute, and platform_storage mappings to carry credential-shaped values. Include raw_config in the same boundary contract so the successor is complete even if the open #1468 branch merges first. Preserve legitimate benchmark tuning/configuration fields and apply filtering structurally at the export chokepoints rather than by a deny-list of only the observed keys. This successor repairs the create-time scope omission found by adversarial lint: database.py and schema.py test coverage is explicitly included.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not duplicate the open #1468 implementation without re-driving its raw_metadata and normalized-block gaps.
anti_patterns.instead: Treat #1468 as a dependency and make this successor’s gate cover all sources and layers.
anti_patterns.why: That branch’s direct probe still leaks normalized mapping sentinels and raw_metadata.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not redact all platform metadata indiscriminately.
anti_patterns.instead: Filter credential-shaped material structurally and assert preservation of representative non-secret fields.
anti_patterns.why: Downstream benchmark analysis depends on legitimate tuning/configuration values.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not sanitize only raw_config or only the public payload.
anti_patterns.instead: Drive distinct sentinels through every export and database chokepoint.
anti_patterns.why: The defect is a multi-boundary value-materialisation gap and the private/database layers are separate consumers.

preserves.behavior: All public, private, and database serialization entry points.
Existing anonymize=False private/export semantics except for credential material that must never egress.
Non-secret benchmark tuning and platform metadata needed by downstream analysis.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from datetime import datetime; from benchbox.core.results.models import BenchmarkResults; from benchbox.core.results.schema import build_result_payload; r=BenchmarkResults(benchmark_name="synthetic",platform="synthetic",scale_factor=1.0,execution_id="gate",timestamp=datetime.now(),duration_seconds=0.1,total_queries=0,successful_queries=0,failed_queries=0,platform_info={"sort_key":"o_orderkey","threads":4},platform_raw_config={"password":"RAW_CONFIG_GATE"},platform_raw_metadata={"password":"RAW_METADATA_GATE"},platform_deployment={"token":"DEPLOYMENT_GATE"},platform_cloud={"access_key":"CLOUD_GATE"},platform_compute={"connection_string":"COMPUTE_GATE"},platform_storage={"secret":"STORAGE_GATE"}); t=json.dumps(build_result_payload(r,sanitize_platform_secrets=False),default=str); assert all(x not in t for x in ("RAW_CONFIG_GATE","RAW_METADATA_GATE","DEPLOYMENT_GATE","CLOUD_GATE","COMPUTE_GATE","STORAGE_GATE")), t'
verifications.description: Unfixed-tree gate: raw_config, raw_metadata, and all four normalized metadata blocks must not appear in a result payload; current develop leaks at least one sentinel.
verifications.expected: FAIL on unfixed develop: at least one platform metadata sentinel survives the export payload; exits 1 before the complete boundary fix and 0 after it.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; o=sanitize_platform_options({"sort_key":"o_orderkey","partition_key":"l_orderkey","primary_key":"id","threads":4}); assert o.get("sort_key")=="o_orderkey" and o.get("partition_key")=="l_orderkey" and o.get("threads")==4, o'
verifications.description: Regression guard: non-secret platform option fields remain available to structural filtering consumers.
verifications.expected: PASS on current develop and after the change: legitimate tuning/configuration values are preserved.

work_units.summary: Re-run the five-source public/private/database sentinel gate on current develop and check #1468 status.
Unify structural filtering for raw and normalized platform metadata at every export boundary.
Add distinct leak and preservation assertions for every mapping and serialization layer.
Run targeted results checks and the sentinel invariant regression guards.
